verdict.rationale: Consensus's own llms.txt advertises an OpenAPI spec as a machine-readable API contract, and it documents versioned JSON REST endpoints. A hands-on probe, however, found the linked spec host fails TLS with a certificate for an unrelated domain, consensus.app/openapi.json returns 403, and the developer docs site is Cloudflare-walled, so no downloadable spec was reachable. Missing for 10: a reachable, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) file, accessible developer docs hosting the spec, independent confirmation that the spec matches the live API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: search, paper detail, synthesis, and the Consensus Meter as stable, versioned JSON endpoints with bearer-token authentication
